decision.rationale: The pin work after the move to D-195 is correct, all thirty-five digests recompute, HEAD matches, the subject is unmoved at 0444, the seven-obligation ledger partitions exactly, the leftoverDesign set is still [OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING], and the named lists match harness and catalog byte-for-byte. The constraint unique to this lineage was checked hardest and holds: DR-102 is SATISFIED at file 08 with CC-1..CC-11 execution remaining at condition 4 / DR-G21, and the subject carries a dedicated obligation that tracks that cell almost verbatim, reopening nothing. One SHOULD-FIX stands. leftoverDesignOpenStanding rests a present-tense claim — leftover-design 'remains on doctor-actor leftover-join.v6 / DR-114' — on the superseded predecessor, while registerRowNote and doctorJoinV6.role both declare v6 historical and not current and name v11 as the current DR-114 source. The mismatch is not only of currency: v6's ledger carries eight leftoverDesign members including OBL-JOIN-FX-EXECUTION, v11's carries seven without it, and the sentence names the seven — so it attributes v11's standing to v6, while the adjacent obligation states in terms that OBL-JOIN-FX-EXECUTION is leftoverDesign false on v11. The subject's own purpose is to cite v11 as the current DR-114 remainder, and that replacement was carried through four other places and missed here, making this an incomplete landing of the artifact's own stated purpose. Across the six sibling gate joins recorded at D-190 through D-195, the only live field citing the superseded row join is registerRowNote and only to declare it not current; this subject is the sole outlier. It is not a blocker because no obligation value moves, the correct source is already pinned, and the repair is a citation swap whose target set the sentence already names. The ACCEPT bar is 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, so the verdict is REJECT.
